newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Tool Works raises dividend 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Tool Works raises dividend 26 pct.

text.p: Illinois Tool Works Inc said Friday its board of directors voted to raise the quarterly cash dividend to $0.24 a share from $0.19.
The dividend will be payable on July 25 to shareholders of record on June 30.
Illinois Tool Works also said shareholders approved an increase in shares of the company's stock to 350 million from 150 million to accommodate a two-for-one stock split announced in February.
The stock split will be effective May 27 for stockholders of record on May 20.
Illinois Tool Works manufactures highly-engineered components and industrial systems.
